name: rustfmt-magic
description: Rust formatter with user-controlled layout: magic trailing commas, first-argument expansion, single-line ifs, and = alignment on top of rustfmt.

rustfmtMagic.binaryPath.description: Absolute path to a rustfmt-magic binary. If empty, the platform binary bundled in the extension's bin/ folder is used.

rustfmtMagic.rustfmtPath.description: Absolute path to the rustfmt binary to delegate to. If empty, ~/.cargo/bin/rustfmt is used, then rustfmt on PATH.
